name: agallaoui-dnd-monorepo
description: Modular drag-and-drop library with core and board extensions

scripts.publish:core: npm run build:core && npm publish -w @agallaoui/dnd-core --access public
scripts.publish:board: npm run build:core && npm run build:board && npm publish -w @agallaoui/board-dnd --access public
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:core && npm run publish:board

author: agallaoui
